meta.purpose: Teaching example. Synthetic or public data, small models, not for prediction.

data.egfr: 110 - 0.85*max(age-30,0) + N(0,12), clipped to 20-120 mL/min/1.73 m2 (correlated with age)

norm.note: all five inputs are z-scored with training-split mean and SD

test_scatter.note: 120 fixed samples drawn from the 300 held-out test patients

oracle_true_function.note: R2 reached by the noise-free true function on the same test set (ceiling set by the noise)

gradcheck.method: central finite differences, h=1e-6, all parameters, mean-squared-error loss on 24 training patients
